mechanism_of_action.plain_language: 225Ac-LNC1011 appears to be an investigational actinium-225-labeled targeted radiopharmaceutical. Publicly accessible source material sufficient to verify the binding target and detailed mechanism was not identified.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: Targeted delivery of alpha-particle radiation from actinium-225 to antigen-expressing cells is presumed by naming convention, but the specific ligand/antibody target for LNC1011 could not be verified from accessible evidence.
downstream_effects: Alpha-particle emission can cause dense DNA double-strand breaks and localized cytotoxicity
